page.overview:
What is Obsidias?

Obsidias is a plane mentioned briefly in the graphic novel Mezlok's Challenge. Mezlok established a link with the red mana of the mountains there, which he used to power his lightning spells. Obsidias had a Infinite Consortium safehouse set up by Baltrice.

It was later conquered and compleated by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion.
